Cointelegraph Seeks Buyer as Traffic Plunges From 12 Million to 700K Visits

Cointelegraph, one of the largest and longest-running crypto news outlets, is seeking a buyer after a Google manual penalty in October 2025 reportedly slashed its organic search traffic by around 80%, according to CoinDesk. Similarweb data show monthly visits plunged from over 12 million in December 2024 to just above 700,000 by early September 2026. Founded in 2013 and employing more than 200 people, Cointelegraph has not disclosed an asking price or responded to requests for comment. — link

Vitalik Buterin Warns AI Could Undermine Cryptography Within Two Years

Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin warned that AI could accelerate mathematical advances enough to weaken lattice-based cryptography, including ML-DSA and FHE, within two years, potentially putting ECDSA at risk sooner than expected. He said Ethereum’s Lean roadmap is shifting toward hash-based signatures to reduce these risks. Buterin advised users to favor addresses that have never sent transactions and use off-chain multisig signing where practical, while cautioning against rushed asset migrations. — link

Kalshi Asks CFTC to Approve a Never-Expiring WTI Crude Futures Contract

Kalshi has filed a proposal with the Commodity Futures Trading Commission for a never-expiring futures contract tied to the WTI crude benchmark, Bloomberg reported. If approved, it would be the first crude oil perpetual traded on a US-regulated platform. The CFTC has 45 days to approve or reject it. The contract is planned to trade 24 hours a day, five days a week. Kalshi’s commodity-market volume was close to $400 million as of early September. — link

Bitmine Chairman Tom Lee said the company will stop accumulating ETH once its holdings reach 5% of the token’s circulating supply. Noah Raises $16 Million, Bringing Total Seed Funding to $38 Million

Stablecoin payments infrastructure company Noah has raised an additional $16 million, bringing its total seed funding to $38 million. The round included Endeit Capital, FJ Labs, LocalGlobe and Felix Capital.

Noah said it has added more than 150 customers since the start of 2026, operates across over 150 markets and supports more than 60 currencies. The funds will support regulatory expansion, hiring and its U.S. expansion. — link

Ledger launched Crypto Loan. Eligible users can post cbBTC or wBTC in Ledger Wallet and borrow USDC or USDT without selling bitcoin. Private keys and final confirmation stay on the hardware device.
